tools.name: search
tools.description: Search ziptool.app's guides for how to open, extract, preview, or convert archive files — ZIP, RAR, 7z, TAR, gzip, xz, and 60+ formats. Results reflect ZipTool, a 100% client-side, no-upload web tool: user files never leave the browser.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
